plugins.name: git-kit
plugins.description: Git and GitHub workflow toolkit: commit and PR creation, GitHub CLI operations, git worktrees, notes, bisect, branch lifecycle setup and post-merge sync, branch cleanup, rebase syncing, merge conflict resolution, commit-shaping guidance, PR review summaries, PR issue-linking and reviewer orchestration, issue drafting, freestanding-issue lifecycle management (create/triage/relate/resolve), dependency updates, gated PR merging, CODEOWNERS management, recovering a stuck Codex-review check, cross-vendor (Claude + Codex) adversarial pre-PR review, and triaging/resolving PR review findings across rounds with a mandated fix-or-file cap.

plugins.name: analysis-kit
plugins.description: Session analysis toolkit for Claude Code: component retrospectives, tool/framework auditing, actor behavior analysis, governance and conflict detection, session/specification comparison, recurring-pattern mining, cross-report findings review, classified improvement recommendations, and third-party review-learnings mining/management — grounded in a session, date range, or a set of merged PRs, with reports persisted for later reference, a guided front door to pick the right analysis type without needing to already know the other skills' names, and a multi-run orchestrator that consolidates several analyses into one prioritized action list and hands off to a guided fix pass.

plugins.name: codex-kit
plugins.description: Delegate work to OpenAI's Codex CLI from Claude Code, with independent verification instead of blind trust: native and adversarial code review, task rescue with diff double-check, document/plan verification, cross-model research, job/session management, an optional stop-time quality gate, and a generic reviewer-agnostic bridge wired into this repository's own marketplace PR pipeline via repository-owned Python, not via any codex-kit skill. Bundles its own Codex engine — replaces OpenAI's official codex plugin rather than depending on it.

plugins.name: workmanagement-kit
plugins.description: The sole Notion/Linear access point for this repository: capture and manage knowledge (Ideas, Decisions, proposed Goals, Notes, Research, Reports, Outcomes, Learning) in Notion and accepted execution (Goals, Roadmaps, Projects, Milestones, Issues) in Linear; deliberately promote accepted knowledge into tracked Linear work; produce dated, non-live Linear-to-Notion status and learning summaries; maintain stable cross-system links with drift detection and bounded repair; revalidate and disposition open follow-up items; and provide a governed cross-plugin intake gate so no other plugin in this repository needs its own Notion or Linear connector. Two read-only Codex reviewer personas — standalone now via the Codex CLI, with a live path via codex-kit's codex-review-bridge pending this plugin's own bridge-caller script — review transitions, closures, and ambiguous intake; Claude Code is the only agent that mutates either system.
